article.title: A Short History of Public Libraries
article.content: Public libraries were created to make knowledge accessible to everyone, not only to wealthy people. In many cities, libraries became centers for reading, research, and community events. As technology developed, libraries added computers, digital archives, and online borrowing services. Today, a library is more than a room full of books. It is a public space where people can study quietly, attend workshops, and explore new ideas. Although reading habits have changed, the core mission remains the same: equal access to information.
article.translation: 公共图书馆的建立是为了让所有人都能获取知识，而不仅仅是富人。在许多城市，图书馆逐渐成为阅读、研究和社区活动中心。随着技术发展，图书馆加入了电脑、数字档案和线上借阅服务。今天，图书馆已不只是“装满书的房间”，而是人们安静学习、参加讲座、探索新想法的公共空间。尽管阅读习惯发生了变化，其核心使命没有变：让信息公平可得。
